name: PCB Modification & Rework
description: Physical modification of PCBs to enable security analysis. Covers component removal and replacement (BGA reballing, QFN rework), trace cutting and jumper wiring, interposer installation for bus interception, decoupling capacitor removal for fault injection preparation, and installation of monitoring taps. Critical supporting skill for many hardware attack techniques.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to PCB modification or rework

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands PCB rework techniques and their role in hardware security analysis
evidence: Can describe common PCB modification techniques (trace cut, jumper wire, component swap)
Understands why PCB modification is necessary for many hardware attacks
Aware of soldering and rework station equipment and basic operation

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Performs basic PCB modifications on practice boards under supervision
evidence: Solders and desolders through-hole and basic SMD components (0805, SOIC)
Cuts traces and installs jumper wires for signal rerouting on practice boards
Removes decoupling capacitors for voltage glitch preparation under guidance
Installs wire taps for bus monitoring on identified signal pads

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently performs PCB modifications on production targets without damaging functionality
evidence: Removes and replaces fine-pitch SMD components (0402, QFN) without board damage
Installs interposers for bus interception between IC and PCB
Prepares target boards for fault injection (power rail isolation, shunt installation)
Modifications maintain target device functionality for continued analysis
Completed PCB modification tasks on 3+ engagement targets successfully

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Performs complex rework on high-density boards; designs custom interposer boards
evidence: Performs BGA reballing and replacement on production targets
Designs and fabricates custom interposer PCBs for bus interception
Modifies multi-layer boards with buried component access requirements
Mentors team on soldering technique, rework procedures, and modification planning

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Recognized authority on PCB rework for security analysis; defines lab capability
evidence: Defines the lab's PCB rework capability requirements and equipment specifications
Develops standard modification procedures for common hardware attack preparations
Performs rework on the most challenging targets (01005 components, ultra-fine-pitch BGA)
Trains teams on advanced soldering and rework techniques for security analysis

assessment_methods.description: Prepare a target PCB for a specified attack: remove/replace components, install monitoring taps, and verify continued device functionality
Observe soldering technique, rework station operation, and modification quality during a live PCB rework session

equipment: Hot air rework station with precision nozzle set
BGA reballing station and stencil kit
